comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: 70+, you mean? I managed it by gathering Lumber trade goods, then "contributing" them to Florence via Craftsman (any town craftsman will suffice) -- when you get a message that says, "The Florentine craftsman will be pleased!", or something along those lines, head to Florence, and talk to Lorenzo di Medici. A quick little cutscene plays, and afterward, the 70+ level cap is released.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: Oh, and to follow the above steps, when you talk to a Craftsman, look for a button marked "Share Info". That's what lets you send trade goods to Florence.
